laws: Preserved sources/zubaida/*.txt stay verbatim; this is additive metadata.
No identity merge without explicit evidence; ambiguities stay explicit.
Annaris != Deyhamora despite legacy annaris-deyhamora slug.
Medical Lord Kaelen is not merged with Kaelen Redalious/Vanguard/Grand Architect Kaelen.
Unnamed creator is unresolved and is not merged with Michael.
Michael is source_person_in_text where reviewed narrative evidence identifies the Author; this does not create a fictional-character page.
Specific unnamed people/simulation subjects are retained without invented names; generic groups are collectives.
A source-named entity that has no confirmed current encyclopedia page remains graph-resolved but character_slug-unresolved rather than being silently dropped.
